limitations: Supplier handover is an explicit stage-first intake boundary, not an executed action.

Continuous native handling certificates cover constant-yaw affine controls only. Route eligibility is the unchanged C08 directed graph and published analytic connector proof, conditional on captured native envelope; no traffic or engine admission.
